ModMetaData.name: Mors-9: The Awakening
ModMetaData.Author: ketamjjne
ModMetaData.author: YourName
ModMetaData.description:
The Awakening has begun. 50% of the world's automatroids have turned against humanity. 2.7 billion dead in three days. The armistice is shattered. The Second War has begun.
NEW FACTIONS: • Autarchs of Iron (Patched Empire) - Military elite seeking to rebuild the old order • Colonial Remnant (Patched DMS_Army) - The last defenders of the armistice • Automatroid Hive Mind (New) - The collective intelligence that turned on humanity • Rust Cult (New) - Fanatics who worship the machines • Scrap-Kin (Patched Tribes) - Descendants of survivors who fear the machines • Hades Compact (Patched Outlanders) - Neutral survivors trying to stay out of the war • The Ancients (Patched VFE Ancients) - The scientists who created the automatroids • Iron Wraiths (Patched Pirates) - Terrorists thriving in the chaos
SCENARIO: "The Awakening" Start as three survivors in an abandoned bunker. You hold the key to the Dead Man's Switch. The world is burning. What will you do?
